Installation¶

Prerequisites¶

  • Python 3.12 or later (see .python-version)

  • uv (pip install uv)

Install¶

Run the following commands to import the project from the distant repo:

git clone https://github.com/pmarlier/streamlit_sncf.git
cd streamlit_sncf
uv sync --dev

This app requires the following dependencies:

  • Python (>=3.12)

  • pandas

  • pydeck

  • streamlit

  • seaborn

  • matplotlib-inline

  • ipykernel

  • sphinx

  • sphinx-autoapi

  • streamlit-folium

  • unidecode

  • geopy

  • plotly

  • colorlog

  • colorama

  • mypy

  • pre-commit

  • pytest

  • pytest-cov

  • ruff
